facts.name: Crystal Sconiers
facts.role: Clerk of Circuit Court and Comptroller
facts.assignment: Walton County Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller; county and circuit court services.

contact.contact_note: Main office line: option 1 court services, option 2 official records, option 0 operator. Court-records login support: eSupport@WaltonClerkFL.Gov. Records-request displayed email conflicts with its link target; see recorded discrepancy.
contact.hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Central Time, except scheduled holidays.

filing.summary: Clerk page states no paper follow-up for previously e-filed originals unless required by court order, statute or procedural rule; links Florida Courts eFiling Portal.

records_access.summary: Use official court-records and official-records entry pages. Court-records page requires disclaimer acceptance; registered attorney access requests use the linked three-page agreement. Published search results carry the clerk’s accuracy/official-record limitations.

review_scope.collected: Six original browser HTTP responses, text, timestamps, link targets; six initial HTTP-200 block bodies retained as failed acquisitions.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Clerk name/role, office and branch contacts/hours, e-filing exception, records entry/access instructions; child-support page screened only for named shared officer.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Biographical details, family enforcement rules, linked forms and authorization-letter history not substantively reviewed.

conflicts.statement: Records Requests displays ClerkRecords@WaltonClerkFL.Gov but href is mailto:Payroll@WaltonClerkFL.Gov. Both retained; no controlling email selected.

gaps: No personal clerk email, named personal assistant or assistant-only telephone established on reviewed official pages.
